guide.text: Gives Harley Quinn starting Energy, letting her cast her Ultimate early and enter [Self-Actualization]. Heals her on kills to keep her momentum going. When hit by enemy basic attacks, she gains [Frenzy] stacks, increasing her Attack and Physical Defense. Greatly improves her staying power when diving in to finish off enemies.
